name: @quifox/agent-plugin-memory
description: Codex v2 memory adapted to Chat conversations and shared Agent plugins

scripts.build: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-compaction build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-compaction build && bun run --filter @quifox/agent-plugin-request-context build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun test/dist-import.mjs
